Return all committed entries whose vector clock is NOT already dominated by the peer's clock.
committed_log_mutex_
Input parameter.

An entry's vector clock VC_e is dominated by peer_clock if VC_e.happensBefore(peer_clock) is true — meaning the peer has already seen this entry. Any entry where that is false is potentially missing from the peer and must be resent.
